Class Cylinder

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.mdi3D.item3D.Item3D
edu.cnu.mdi.mdi3D.item3D.Cylinder
public class Cylinder extends Item3D
A solid cylindrical tube between two endpoints, with a fixed radius, optional extension beyond its defining endpoints, and optional Phong-style lighting.

    • setLighted

      public void setLighted(boolean lighted)
      Enable or disable Phong-style lighting for this cylinder.

      When enabled, the tube is drawn with smooth per-vertex normals via Support3D.drawShadedTube(GLAutoDrawable, float, float, float, float, float, float, float, Color, boolean), so shading visibly changes as the cylinder (or the scene around it) rotates. Disabled by default, matching the flat-colour appearance existing callers already expect.

      Parameters:
      lighted - true to enable lighting; false for flat colour
